description: Search structured products using exact SKU or GTIN, supplier, material, dimensions, MOQ, price, inventory state, lead time and qualification filters. Returns approved merchant listings; inventory may be unknown and must be freshly confirmed before quote or order.

category.description: Exact normalized product category, for example jewelry or hair-accessories.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for price filtering, normally USD.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous search response.

environment.description: Catalog environment. Only production reviewed listings are publicly available.

gtin.description: Exact GTIN, UPC or EAN identifier when supplied by the merchant.

inventoryStatus.description: Inventory evidence filter. confirmed means supplier-confirmed sellable units; unknown means a fresh confirmation is required.

limit.description: Number of results to return; server clamps this to a safe maximum of 100.

material.description: Case-insensitive material filter, such as stainless steel or acetate.

maxLeadTimeDays.description: Maximum stated supplier lead time in calendar days.

maxMoq.description: Maximum acceptable order quantity in whole units.

maxPrice.description: Maximum unit price in the requested currency.

minInventory.description: Minimum currently sellable inventory in whole units; unknown inventory is not counted.

minMoq.description: Minimum acceptable order quantity in whole units.

minPrice.description: Minimum unit price in the requested currency.

q.description: Free-text search across SKU, product name, material, size, category and supplier name.

qualificationStatus.description: Merchant qualification text to match, such as verified or reviewed.

size.description: Case-insensitive size or dimension filter using the merchant value.

sku.description: Exact public SKU identifier; use this for a single known product.

supplierId.description: Stable BuyingMesh supplier ID returned by search_suppliers or get_supplier.

supplierSlug.description: Public supplier slug from the supplier storefront URL.

verifiedOnly.description: When true, return only listings with a verified supplier or qualification signal.

name: search_products

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.
